highlights: Advanced Health Monitoring – Built-in ECG and heart rate sensors provide convenient health and heart activity tracking.
Multiple Health Estimations – Supports estimated readings for blood glucose, uric acid, blood lipids, BMI, and body fat.
HRV & Sleep Analysis – Monitor heart rate variability and sleep quality to better understand daily wellness patterns.
AI-Assisted Health Insights – Get intelligent insights based on your tracked health and activity data.
10-Day Battery Life – Enjoy extended use between charges for convenient everyday monitoring.
Durable & Water Resistant – Features a durable metal design with IPX8 water resistance for comfortable all-day wear.
The Porodo TrackFit Neo Smart Health Tracking Band with Comprehensive Health Monitoring  in Black tracks your health accurately without the bulk of a screen.
It includes an ECG sensor to check your heart’s condition precisely, plus monitors heart rate, sleep quality, BMI, body fat, blood glucose, uric acid, and HRV.
AI-powered insights and Google Health link make it easy to follow important wellness numbers.
With more than 100 sport modes, it handles any activity you throw at it. The light zinc alloy frame and soft 25mm band feel good all day, and IPX8 water resistance adds extra durability.
Fast magnetic charging keeps it powered for up to 10 days. You’ll get smart call and alert notifications, and it works with both Android and iOS devices.
This smart band fits anyone wanting thorough health tracking in a sleek, simple wearable.
